title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Slab Positions of Billed Detention Days
content:
Each detention day billed on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record is priced at the rate of the slab it falls in, and its slab depends on its position in a slab count.

## Where the detention slab count begins

| Clock arrangement | Direction | Position of the first billed detention day |
|---|---|---|
| separate clocks | import or export | 1: the first detention day opens the count |
| combined clock | export | 1: counting begins at the merged clock's earliest chargeable day |
| combined clock | import | one beyond the chargeable demurrage days that come ahead of the detention days in the merged clock |

Every later detention day takes the next position.

## From position to slab

- A position no greater than the first slab length is in slab 1.
- A position greater than that, but no greater than the first and second slab lengths together, is in slab 2.
- A position greater than that, but no greater than the three slab lengths together, is in slab 3.
- Any position beyond the three slab lengths together is in slab 4.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical slab lengths of 4, 4 and 8 days)

| Input | Positions occupied | Days per slab |
|---|---|---|
| separate import record, 6 detention days billed | 1 to 6 | slab 1: 4, slab 2: 2 |
| merged import record, 3 chargeable demurrage days ahead, 9 detention days billed | 4 to 12 | slab 1: 1, slab 2: 4, slab 3: 4 |
| merged export record, 18 detention days billed | 1 to 18 | slab 1: 4, slab 2: 4, slab 3: 8, slab 4: 2 |
| merged import record, no chargeable demurrage day ahead, 5 detention days billed | 1 to 5 | slab 1: 4, slab 2: 1 |

The number of detention days in each slab is the count of the occupied positions that fall inside that slab's band.
